subject: Compliance add-ons pricing & KMS/HSM integration
messages:
From: Ava Hargrove <ava.hargrove@medixhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Monroe <jake.monroe@medixhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@medixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency, HIPAA

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the intro last week. We're kicking off the internal procurement / security review for adding Redwood to our inference stack on a pilot for clinical summarization. Before we can move to an SOW, security is asking for a pricing breakdown and packaging options for the following compliance items:

- Audit logs (retention tiers: 30d, 1yr, 7yr) and exportability for audits
- Customer-managed KMS / HSM support (requirement: bring-your-own-key with rotation policy)
- Data residency: ability to keep PHI in US-only regions (and Europe option for future)
- HIPAA BAA and any additional attestations/evidence (SOC2 report, encryption at rest/in-flight specifics)

Can you send a short pricing matrix (one-pager) that shows recurring and one-time fees, and any discounts for reserved/committed capacity (12/36-month)? Also include an estimate for integration/setup time (work effort) if we choose the private or dedicated path with a customer-managed HSM.

Looping in Jake (security) and procurement for visibility. Attached is a short requirements doc for context.

Appreciate a reply by Thu COB if possible — procurement would like numbers to include in the next vendor comparison.

Thanks,

Ava Hargrove
Director, IT Security
Medix Health Systems
ava.hargrove@medixhealth.com
(415) 555-0187

Ava — thanks for the clear requirements and the doc.

Quick note to say we'll put together a concise pricing matrix and packaging options. Looping in Monica (sales lead for healthcare) and Priyom (solutions / security integrations) to scope the KMS/HSM work and the residency options. Monica — can you draft the two pricing paths (Hosted + Compliance Add-on vs Dedicated/Private with customer-managed HSM) and an initial discount schedule for 12/36-month commitments?

Priyom — can you flag any red flags from a technical/setup perspective (estimated integration days, gating docs we need, and whether we can meet the BYOK rotation requirements without a private appliance)?

Ava / Jake — we'll aim to send a one-page matrix + an appendix with assumptions by Thu COB. If there's a preferred format for procurement (e.g., line-item CSV), let us know.

Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency, HIPAA

On Tue, Apr 7, 2026 at 10:03 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Ava — thanks for the clear requirements and the doc.

Thanks — a couple clarifications from security to help price accurately:

- Pilot expected to generate ~120M input tokens / month (model calls for extractive summarization), with peak concurrency of ~40 qps.
- Audit logs: we need write-once logs exportable as NDJSON and retention options at 30d, 1yr, and 7yr (7yr required for certain records).
- KMS: we will require BYOK with HSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 equivalent), key rotation every 90 days (we can do key versions on our side but need compatibility with Redwood), and proof of zero-knowledge integration (no plaintext keys stored on your side).
- Data residency: start with US-only region (multi-AZ), but please provide EU option pricing for a later rollout.
- HIPAA: BAA required; we also need SOC2 Type II report and a short description of logging access controls.

If you can provide a line-item with one-time setup and monthly recurring costs, plus an estimated lead time for HSM integration (calendar days), that will be perfect.

Jake Monroe
Sr. Security Engineer
Medix Health Systems

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Hargrove <ava.hargrove@medixhealth.com>, Jake Monroe <jake.monroe@medixhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency, HIPAA

Hi Ava/Jake — thanks for the detail. I attached a short pricing matrix (redwood_compliance_tiers_v1.pdf) and below is a concise summary and assumptions. Happy to convert to CSV or a formal quote once you confirm package choice.

Summary (recurring / one-time):

1) Hosted + Compliance Add-on (fastest path)
- Audit logs: 30d retention included; 1yr retention + exportability: $1,200/mo; 7yr retention: $3,600/mo (indexed by TB stored; see appendix for per-GB rate).
- KMS (BYOK soft integration): Customer-managed keys supported for envelope encryption; no HSM appliance. Monthly key-management surcharge: $400/mo.
- HIPAA / BAA: Included at no extra recurring cost (we sign standard BAA for enterprise).
- Setup: 5-10 business days for onboarding; no one-time HSM setup fee.

2) Dedicated / Private (recommended for strict HSM requirements)
- One-time HSM integration/setup: $20,000 (includes connector/dev time + validation).
- HSM monthly key ledger fee (HSM provisioning & audit): $1,200/mo.
- Audit logs: same retention tiers but includes on-prem export connector: 1yr = $900/mo, 7yr = $2,700/mo (discounted for Dedicated).
- Private deployment (VPC + US-only residency): additional base platform fee $4,000/mo (includes reserved capacity).
- Setup lead time: typically 6-10 weeks end-to-end for Private + HSM (scheduling dependent).

Discounts / packaging:
- 12-month committed spend: 15% off recurring add-on fees.
- 36-month committed spend: 25% off recurring add-on fees and a waiver of up to $10k of one-time setup (applies to HSM setup).
- Additional volume discounts available once token usage > 500M/month (we can price seat-by-seat or token-based).

Assumptions / Notes:
- BYOK HSM: for Dedicated path we integrate with customer HSM via standard PKCS#11 or cloud-HSM connectors; Redwood never stores plaintext keys. We provide key-wrap envelope model and rotation hooks to call customer key ops.
- SOC2 Type II report: available under NDA; we can provide latest report and a controls mapping.
- For HIPAA: we will sign BAA and provide control descriptions for access logging, IAM, and encryption in transit/rest.

Next steps: please confirm which path (Hosted-Compliance vs Dedicated+HSM) and whether you want a 12- or 36-month commitment. Once you confirm, we'll produce a formal SOW and quote (PDF) with line items and a draft SOW.

Attachments: redwood_compliance_tiers_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency, HIPAA

Monica — this is exactly what we needed, thank you.

High-level decision from procurement/security: we want to proceed with the Dedicated + HSM path and prefer a 36-month commitment if you can apply the 25% recurring discount and waive $10k of the one-time HSM setup (the team authorized up to $10k waiver). Please prepare a formal quote + SOW including:

- Line-items for the Dedicated base fee, HSM one-time integration (net after waiver), monthly HSM ledger fee, audit-log retention (7yr), and any assumed TB estimates used to calculate storage.
- Clear lead time and milestones for the 6-10 week integration.
- BAA and SOC2 disclosure (we can execute NDA for the SOC2).
- Draft of key rotation policy compatibility requirements for our HSM admin.

If you can get a draft quote to procurement@medixhealth.com and myself by EOD Mon, we can start the internal approval cycle. Also propose a 30-minute alignment call next Tue to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Ava
